Green Bet from Paris Corner TOP NOTES:-BERGAMOT, LIME, SPICES HEART NOTES:-NEROLI, AROMATIC, VIOLET, ROSE BASE NOTES:-GUAIACWOOD, AMBER DRY, INCENSE, CEDARWOOD Green Bet is a bold expression of freshness, where vibrant citrus meets refined woody depth. It opens with sparkling bergamot, zesty lime, and warm spices, creating a crisp yet confident first impression. The heart unfolds with luminous neroli, aromatic herbs, violet, and rose, bringing a fresh elegance with subtle complexity. As it settles, guaiacwood, dry amber, incense, and cedarwood leave a smoky, sophisticated trail that lingers with quiet confidence. Clean, distinctive, and effortlessly modern — a fragrance that plays by its own rules.

Heer by Paris Corner TOP NOTES:-GINGER, BLACK CURRANT, GRAPEFRUIT HEART NOTES:-TUBEROSE, GREEN ACCORD, WHITE FLOWERS BOUQUET BASE NOTES:-MUSK, VETIVER, CAHSMERAN Heer is a graceful fragrance that blends vibrant freshness with quiet sophistication. It opens with the lively sparkle of ginger, black currant, and grapefruit, creating a crisp, energetic first impression. The heart blossoms into an elegant bouquet of tuberose, lush green accords, and delicate white flowers, bringing a sense of effortless refinement. As it settles, musk, vetiver, and cashmeran wrap the composition in a soft, velvety warmth that lingers beautifully. Heer is poised, radiant, and effortlessly elegant — a scent that leaves a lasting impression through subtle confidence rather than excess. &nbsp;

It opens with juicy orange and sweet strawberry, creating a bright and uplifting first impression. The heart melts into soft marshmallow and delicate orange flower, adding a dreamy, airy elegance. As it settles, creamy vanilla and smooth musk wrap the skin in a warm, lingering embrace. It is joyful, feminine, and irresistibly captivating — a scent made to shine effortlessly. TOP NOTES:-GRAPEFRUIT, BERGAMOT, GINGER CANDY ACCORD HEART NOTES:-ORANGE BLOSSOM, LILY OF THE VALLEY BASE NOTES:-MUSK, SANDALWOOD, AMBER Ciao Citrus is a sparkling and uplifting fragrance that radiates pure sunshine and effortless charm. It opens with an energizing burst of grapefruit, bergamot, and a playful ginger candy accord, creating a fresh yet addictive introduction. The heart blooms with luminous orange blossom and delicate lily of the valley, adding a soft floral elegance. As it settles, warm musk, creamy sandalwood, and glowing amber leave a smooth, comforting trail.
